channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: At least 40 killed in passenger bus crash in southwest Pakistan
item.description: Bus lost control and fell into the rocky ravine near border of Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, officials say.

item.title: Khamenei’s coffin readied as Iran prepares for seven-day funeral
item.description: Former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's coffin has been readied as Iran prepares for seven-day funeral.

item.title: Mapping Iran’s Ali Khamenei funeral: Where mourners will gather each day
item.description: Funeral processions for Iran's late supreme leader will take place between July 3-9 across Iran and Iraq.

item.title: Papua rebels claim to have killed US pilot in Indonesia
item.description: A US pilot has been killed in Indonesia’s Papua region after separatist rebels said they shot him.

item.title: Iran warns ships against using unapproved routes in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Military command issues threat a day after Qatari mediators hailed 'positive progress' in indirect US-Iranian talks.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran slams US before huge funeral for Ali Khamenei
item.description: Lebanon's Health Ministry says at least 4,298 people have been killed and 12,196 injured in Israeli attacks since March.

item.title: On the Strait of Hormuz, BBC finds seized ships and shark fishermen as uneasy calm returns
item.description: The BBC travels to the city of Bandar Abbas - the first international journalists to visit the Iranian side of the strait.

item.title: Iran begins public mourning for Ayatollah killed in February
item.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla from Friday ahead of days-long funeral events.

item.title: Ebola treatments trial begins in DR Congo
item.description: According to WHO data, there have been 1,406 confirmed cases of the disease in DRC, with 301 suspected cases and 438 deaths.

item.title: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
item.description: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.
